div.head: Leis Wl 50
div.ab: E ki le cri orat e sursera, la sursise l[e] rei amend, u s’en espurget.
De non insequentibus clamorem. Qui clamore audito insequi supersederit, de sursisa erga regem emendet, nisi se iuramento purgare potuerit.
E ki le cri orat e sursera, la sursise l[e] rei amend u s'en espurget.
50. Und wer das Gerüfte hört und [zu verfolgen] versäumt, büsse die Königs[befehl]-Versäumniss[strafe], oder reinige sich davon.
50. And whoever hears the hue and cry and neglects [to pursue] shall pay the [penalty for] neglect of the king's [command], or clear himself of it.
And if anyone hears the hue and cry and neglects it, he shall pay the fine for neglecting it to the king, or clear himself.
